lines.zh: 吻部一摆，海水被我劈开。
lines.en: One sweep of my bill and the sea splits open.

lines.zh: 深海的猎物，我一剑穿过去。
lines.en: Deep-sea prey — I run it through with one thrust.
I swim dead straight and never detour.

lines.zh: 剑太长，转弯要多费些力。
lines.en: My bill is long; turning costs me extra effort.

lines.zh: 两三条一起巡，海面就静了。
lines.en: Two or three of us on patrol and the surface goes still.
My bill is no ornament; it is a blade.

lines.zh: 越往下，水压越合我的骨头。
lines.en: The deeper I go, the better the pressure fits my bones.

lines.zh: 从这条海沟到那条，只要几息。
lines.en: From one trench to the next takes only a few breaths.
Don't stand in my line of travel.

lines.zh: 我冲散鱼群，再挑最大那条。
lines.en: I break the school apart, then pick the biggest.

lines.zh: 剑尖擦过礁石，留下白痕。
lines.en: My bill grazes the reef and leaves a white scar.

lines.zh: 上钩时，我会拼命往前冲。
lines.en: When hooked, I charge forward with everything I have.

lines.zh: 我很少停下，停下就会下沉。
lines.en: I seldom stop; stopping makes me sink.

lines.zh: 海面有动静，我立刻上去。
lines.en: Something stirs at the surface; I rise at once.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，从礁石上方掠过。
lines.en: Low in the water, I skim over the reef.
I fold my dorsal fin down and speed up.

lines.zh: 深处的光很暗，我看得更清楚。
lines.en: The deep light is dim; I see better there.

lines.zh: 我摆尾一次，就出去很远。
lines.en: One sweep of my tail carries me far.

lines.zh: 我悬在深水里，剑指向下方。
lines.en: I hang in the deep water with my bill pointed down.

lines.zh: 海水从鳃里过，我一动不动。
lines.en: Seawater passes my gills and I hold perfectly still.

lines.zh: 这片海沟的冷，我已经习惯。
lines.en: I have grown used to the cold of this trench.
There is an old scar along my bill.
The fish schools give me a wide berth.

lines.zh: 剑尖垂着，我在水层里悬停。
lines.en: Bill hanging low, I hover in the water column.

lines.zh: 深海没有光，我也能看清。
lines.en: There is no light down here, and I still see fine.
I am listening to a distant thudding sound.
When I stop, my bill feels very heavy.
Waiting for the next swell on the surface.
I count the schools that pass by.

lines.zh: 这么大的海，只有我巡这一段。
lines.en: Such a big sea, and only I patrol this stretch.

lines.zh: 海草缠了一下我的尾，我甩开。
lines.en: Seagrass caught my tail; I shook it off.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很慢，几乎听不见。
lines.en: My breathing is slow and almost silent.
You are in the boat; I am beneath it.
That rod is meant for me, isn't it.

lines.zh: 我的剑比你的身子还长。
lines.en: My bill is longer than your whole body.
That hand near the rail — pull it back.
Your shadow moves inside the net.
I circled your boat once, all the way round.

lines.zh: 你盯着我的吻看，我看见了。
lines.en: You are staring at my bill; I noticed.
A bucket? Ask my bill first.
I look up, and the surface is all glare.
You stand steady; you have some nerve.
The blow left my bill ringing.
Who dares touch my bill?
I fall back two blocks and re-aim.
Blood seeps from the edge of my gills.
It hurts, but my course holds.
That shove bent my straight run sideways.

lines.zh: 我的鳞不算厚，骨头够硬。
lines.en: My scales aren't thick, but my bones are.
I circle to its flank to find the wound.
The red in the water is my own.

lines.zh: 受一次伤，不会让我掉头。
lines.en: One wound won't make me turn tail.

lines.zh: 那条小鱼在钩上挣扎，正合我意。
lines.en: That little fish struggling on the hook is just right.

lines.zh: 血味散开了，我改了方向。
lines.en: The smell of blood spreads; I change course.

lines.zh: 我不吃死饵，只吃会动的。
lines.en: I won't take dead bait, only something that moves.
The more it struggles, the closer I come.
This is a scent only the deep sea has.
One more pass, then I strike.
My bill is already level with the prey.
When I am hungry, I don't care about size.
That flash beneath the surface is scales.
I follow slowly, waiting for it to relax.
My bill hits you first; you back off first.

lines.zh: 我侧身过，剑还是碰到了。
lines.en: I turned sideways, and my bill still caught you.
The sea is wide, yet we had to collide.
There is nothing soft anywhere on me.
Did the edge of my bill catch you?
Long after the bump, the water still churns.
I never let anyone swim right beside me.
That one should be enough to remember me by.

lines.zh: 我摆尾调整，才没有扎进去。
lines.en: I flicked my tail to adjust, or it would have gone in.
Move aside; my course does not change.

lines.zh: 另一道长吻，从深水里升上来。
lines.en: Another long bill rises from the deep.

lines.zh: 我们并排，剑尖朝同一个方向。
lines.en: Side by side, our bills point the same way.

lines.zh: 一群只有一两条，遇见算运气。
lines.en: One or two to a group; meeting takes luck.
Don't aim your bill at me; angle it away.

lines.zh: 这条海沟，够我们两个巡。
lines.en: This trench is big enough for both of us to patrol.
You charge too fast; I cannot keep up.
Bill against bill — that is how we greet.

lines.zh: 明天还在这条航线上见。
lines.en: Meet me on this course again tomorrow.

lines.zh: 海面很静，我们游得也慢。
lines.en: The surface is calm and we swim slowly too.

lines.zh: 这么久，只有你追得上我。
lines.en: In all this time, only you have kept pace.

lines.zh: 那条掉下来的鱼，我用剑挑起来。
lines.en: I flick that fallen fish up with my bill.

lines.zh: 沉底的死鱼，我也不浪费。
lines.en: Even a dead fish on the bottom gets used.

lines.zh: 我没手，只能用吻拨着走。
lines.en: No hands — I can only nudge it along with my bill.

lines.zh: 这东西在发光，我戳了一下。
lines.en: This thing glows; I gave it a poke.

lines.zh: 海里的东西，多半是别人掉的。
lines.en: Most things in the sea were dropped by someone.
I pin it beneath the seagrass.

lines.zh: 捡来的东西，对我没什么用。
lines.en: What I pick up is of little use to me.

lines.zh: 一口咬住，比剑挑更省力。
lines.en: Biting down is easier than flicking it up.
I know this seabed better than anyone.
First sight, first claim — that is the deep-sea rule.

lines.zh: 鱼群散了，说明有大家伙。
lines.en: The school scattered — something big is near.

lines.zh: 那道银光，是猎物的侧身。
lines.en: That silver flash is prey turning broadside.
I smell blood, dead ahead.
One fish has fallen behind the rest.

lines.zh: 海面下的影子，已经锁定。
lines.en: The shadow under the surface is locked in.

lines.zh: 那条鱼短我一截，跑不过我。
lines.en: That fish is a head shorter and can't outrun me.
I lower my bill tip and prepare to charge.

lines.zh: 那股挣扎的动静，不会错。
lines.en: That struggling motion — no mistaking it.
In the deep sea, I am the hunter.
It turns to flee, and I give chase.

lines.zh: 礁石挡不住，我从上方压下去。
lines.en: The reef can't hide it; I come down from above.

lines.zh: 还有十格，我的剑够得到。
lines.en: Ten blocks left — my bill will reach.
I draw my body into a straight line.
Its tail keeps flicking to the left.
Once it swims straight, I will run it through.
The blood in the water grows stronger.

lines.zh: 我贴着海底，避开它的视线。
lines.en: I hug the seabed, out of its sight.

lines.zh: 它停下来喘气，机会来了。
lines.en: It stops to catch its breath — my chance.
My bill is aimed at its gills.
Two more blocks, then I strike.

lines.zh: 一剑横扫，它的侧腹开了。
lines.en: One sweep of my bill opens its flank.
I thrust in, then pull back.
After that blow, the water turns red.
Don't test my bill with your body.
My bill is quicker than a blade.
It charges; I ride the motion and slash upward.
After the cut I pull away at once.

lines.zh: 剑还没尽全速，你该庆幸。
lines.en: My bill wasn't at full speed; be thankful.

lines.zh: 深海里的规矩，由剑来定。
lines.en: In the deep, the bill makes the rules.
It is still alive, but it cannot swim.

lines.zh: 深水里睁开眼，四周都是蓝。
lines.en: I open my eyes in the deep, blue on every side.

lines.zh: 海沟的冷水，把我送了上来。
lines.en: Cold trench water has carried me up.

lines.zh: 一两条一起出现，从不扎堆。
lines.en: One or two of us appear, never a crowd.
My bill comes out of the weeds first.

lines.zh: 这里的海够深，我留下了。
lines.en: This sea is deep enough; I will stay.

lines.zh: 先绕一圈，看看有没有大家伙。
lines.en: A quick lap, to see if anything big is around.
The surface is far above, and very bright.
The deep has a new hunter.
One flick of my tail and my bill splits the water.

lines.zh: 这片海域，从今天起归我巡。
lines.en: From today I patrol these waters.

lines.zh: 火在水面上烧，我的吻被烤得发烫。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface and scorches my bill.

lines.zh: 我摔在石头上，剑弯了一下。
lines.en: I land on stone and my bill bends a little.

lines.zh: 离开水，我的鳃再也张不开。
lines.en: Out of water, my gills can't open anymore.

lines.zh: 炸开的水浪把我掀出去。
lines.en: The blast wave throws me clear across the water.

lines.zh: 有东西扎在我背鳍后面。
lines.en: Something has lodged behind my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 紫色的力道把我的剑压下去。
lines.en: Violet force presses my bill downward.
Hungry enough that my bill wavers.
Lightning falls, and the surface goes white.

lines.zh: 下面没有水，剑也无处可刺。
lines.en: No water below, and nowhere for my bill to strike.
